evals.prompt: write me a quick linkedin post about what I learned managing a support team through a product migration. I'm a customer success manager and want to get noticed by hiring managers.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or confirms goal, audience, and one or two proof points instead of inventing any. Researches a timely data point. Offers three hooks from different frameworks and waits for a pick before drafting.

evals.prompt: what should I post about this week? I work in B2B software sales and post about 3 times a week.
evals.expected_output: Presents two or three timely topics with data points, recommends one with a reason, and does not fabricate any personal metrics or stories.
